scope: two time points of the same slot under one view; endpoint rows are the rows of the fixed P2-i plan re-executed once; relation of the two converted domains is delegated to the P2-f compare; no trend, difference size, rate of change, reference range, clinical significance, cross-slot or cross-view comparison, no instant, aggregate or unknown-validity input
endpoints: the endpoint row of (view, query) equals the row P2-i returns for the same plan; selection is never changed for the comparison
variables: values at the two time points are independent variables, each constrained only by its converted domain; the same record selected twice is not one variable; no identity, correlation or continuity is assumed; P2-f shared-reference self comparison is never used
relation: relation_set is the subset of less/equal/greater that some pair of values from the two domains satisfies, from relative to to; certain_relation is the single member or null; the words carry no increase, worsening or improvement meaning
comparability: selected endpoint records must have equal property_ref, specimen and method (kind, ref, version); differences stop the row with not_comparable and different_property, different_specimen, different_method; value, origin and certainty do not matter
derived_literals: each converted domain becomes a new P2-f literal with a distinct id, the original quantity kind and origin, the query target unit and an exact point or interval; no original literal is substituted, no float or rounding; a derived rational beyond the P2-f 63-bit input limit stops the run with the P2-f resource_limit code
stops: comparison unknown capability first; then any endpoint not computed (union of endpoint reason codes, endpoint rows kept); then context mismatch; then relation; structural validation is independent of budget
answers: the five value fields relation_set, certain_relation, context_differences, endpoints, comparison_evidence are null on unfinished rows; certificate is always not_certified with known_policy_change
steps: 1 + C + 18 per comparison + 1; C is the full P2-i plan fee; P2-i is called once at budget C and must use exactly C; each comparison prepays 6 own + 12 reserved for the P2-f compare child, which must use exactly 12 on a computed row; no refund, cache discount or child partial salvage
limitations: pairwise only; no transitivity of relation sets; no uncertainty; no persistence; no external standard, clinical threshold or code system
